metadata.title: Ballard | Gear that earns its keep
metadata.description: Technical outdoor and work apparel from Seattle, Washington. Founded in 1963.

props.headline: Weather doesn't clock out.
props.description: Ballard makes technical outdoor and work apparel for long hours, wet mornings, and the jobs that keep moving.

props.heading: Start with the conditions.
props.introduction: Choose gear by what the day asks of it. Every category makes room for fit, construction, care, and an honest tradeoff.

cards.title: Outerwear
cards.description: Shells and work jackets for rain, wind, and repeated use.

cards.title: Work layers
cards.description: Shirts, overshirts, and insulation that fit into a working system.

cards.title: Packs and carry
cards.description: Straightforward storage for tools, wet gear, and daily movement.

props.heading: Useful before impressive.
paragraphs: We start with the condition, then choose construction, fit, and materials around the work.
We state the limitation with the benefit. You should know what a piece does, how it fits, and where it gives something up.
props.markAlt: Ballard. Gear that earns its keep. Founded 1963.
